mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate near zero compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative without tightening signals.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate decline below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that boost corporate hiring and earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or Rank IC is less than 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in real GDP and housing starts indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 2.5% annually triggers central bank tightening expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days during high inflation regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% YoY, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction below 100.0 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing output, forecasting negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0, or Rank IC is less than 0.02 over any 3-year window.

failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases when RSAFS exceeds 550,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
